request.style: English, female voice, solemn and dignified solo with string quartet, violins, cellos, harp, organ, majestic and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel
They supplied provisions for the king and his household
Each one was responsible for a month of the year
Their names were recorded in the ancient scroll

[Verse]
Ben-Abinadab ruled in all of Naphath Dor
He had Solomon's daughter Taphath as his wife
A bond of loyalty between the royal house
And the administrative leaders of the land

[Verse]
The hill country of Ephraim held Ben-Hur
Ben-Deker in Makaz and Shaalbim and Beth Shemesh
Ben-Hesed held Arubboth and Socoh and Hepher
Each region provided for the royal needs

[Verse]
Taphath was given to strengthen the kingdom
A political arrangement to ensure stability
Her father had many wives of royal birth
Yet Taphath's union served the state's design

[Outro]
Taphath, Solomon's daughter, wife of Ben-Abinadab
